llm_text: Yeah, that sounds rough — I can imagine being around food makes it way harder. A few things people I’ve talked to swear by (and what I’d try if I did it regularly): start slow (try a 12-hour fast first, then move toward 14–16 hours), push breakfast later rather than skipping other meals, and stay hydrated — water, black coffee or unsweetened tea can take the edge off. Keeping busy and planning satisfying, protein- and fiber-rich meals during your eating window helps too. Also, be flexible: pick a schedule that fits your life so you’re not constantly fighting cravings. And definitely check with a doctor if you have any health concerns.
